product.title: San Diego: The Most Extensive City & Beach Tour
product.description: Get more out of limited time in San Diego by going on a tour that helps you check off multiple highlights, including city and beach locations. As you set off on a scenic drive, a guide helps you get the most out of your trip with live narration and video footage too. Stops along the way include the historic Hotel Del Coronado, the Coronado Bridge, and La Jolla Cove.

start: Pick up is in front of the BANK OF AMERICA building on 655 West Broadway and Kettner by the bus stop, across the street from Santa Fe Depot. Bus will pull up between 9 45 AM and 10 AM. The tour starts at 10 AM. Paid parking at Bank of America building or behind Santa Fe Depot.

itineraryItems.description:
Pick up is in front of the Bank of America building on 655 West Broadway by the bus stop, across the street from Santa Fe Depot. 

Pick up at Cruise Ship Terminal is only when we have cruise passengers.
We visit the historic Gaslamp District and learn about the history of Alonzo Horton and New Town.
Mama MIa! We drive by the largest Little Italy in America.
We take a ride over the San Diego-Coronado Bay Bridge. Witness spectacular views of the San Diego skyline and Coronado.

Discover a great view of Downtown skyline from Ferry Landing and the elegant Hotel Del Coronado, a true historic landmark dating back to 1888. Get some lunch on Orange Avenue, take a stroll on the beach. There is a 50 minute stop in Coronado, the Crown City.
One of the most popular attractions in San Diego. See the seals in their natural habitat. Breath the cool ocean air and explore beautiful La Jolla Cove. There is a 30 minute stop here.
Honor our fallen soldiers and see spectacular views of San Diego.

Take a walk in San Diego's green paradise, the incredible Balboa Park. Home to the famous San Diego Zoo & site of the 1915 Panama California Exposition. The park is also bustling with museums and landmarks. There is a 45 minute stop for you to discover the beauty of this park.

Discover San Diego's roots in Old Town, the birthplace of California. Go back in time as you walk through the historic area and some of its emblematic buildings including the haunted Whaley's House and Casa De Estudillo from 1827.
Santa Fe Depot is our drop off point.

product.itinerarySummary: Santa Fe Depot; Gaslamp Quarter (Pass By); Little Italy (Pass By); Coronado Bridge (Pass By); Coronado; La Jolla Cove; Mt. Soledad National Veterans Memorial (Pass By); Balboa Park; Old Town San Diego; Santa Fe Depot.
highlights: Discover the best of San Diego on this guided tour
See different neighborhoods, including Little Italy
Learn about the history of local sights
